title: always keep wifi on during sleep Android 13
symptom: With Android 13, users get annoying messages about enabling 'always keep wifi on during sleep', but this option was removed after Android 12. The warning appears from time to time even after granting all permissions.
fix: The issue was resolved in the Nov 27th nightly release. The user confirmed no popups for 2 hours after updating.
evidence_quote: This should be resolved in the Nov 27th nightly. Please confirm? thanks
